description: Turn a described need into a link the person opens themselves, where an adviser builds a brief and matches it against suppliers' real stock. This is how someone actually reaches a supplier: there are no contact details in this server, and this call does not contact anyone. It stores nothing and it REFUSES any personal data — no name, no number, no email. Describe the project, not the person.

client.description: Optional: a short name for your app, so we can tell which assistants send people here. Self-reported, lowercase slug.

need.description: The project in the person's own terms, in Persian or English — space, use, style, constraints. No personal details: the call is refused if it contains a phone number, an email or a handle.

name: start_consultation
title: Get the person a link to real advice
